task.title: Require two-factor authentication (2FA) for all users in your organization
task.shortdesc: To promote the security of Red Hat user accounts associated with your organization, the Organization Administrator can enable a two-factor authentication requirement for all users in the organization.

ul.li: Ensure you are using a registered Red Hat account with Organization Administrator permissions.

prereq.note: Google Authenticator and FreeOTP Authenticator are the only supported token generators for providing two-factor authentication one-time codes. Hardware tokens, SMS (text-message) tokens, and other apps are not supported. You can install these apps on your smartphone or other compatible Android or iOS device.

When a user enables individual opt-in two-factor authentication for their user account through their Signing in settings, two-factor authentication remains enabled for their account regardless of organization-level requirements.

step.cmd: Log in to Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console as a user who has Organization Administrator permission.
From the home page after you log in, click ⚙ (Settings).
When the Authentication Policy window appears, click Authentication Factors.
On the Authentication factors page, check Enable two-factor authentication for your organization.

taskbody.result: Once organization-wide two-factor authentication is enabled, all users will be prompted to set up an authenticator app upon their next login. After this initial configuration, a one-time code from the app will be required for every subsequent login.
